## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has a test (bug fixes: a test that fails before the fix)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, `.env` files, or personal paths in the diff (test tokens are built with `glue()`)
- [ ] Documentation is updated: `README.md` and `README.id.md` if behaviour or commands changed
